description: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE mirroring the shape of USCIS's published nonimmigrant temporary-worker visa classification structure for artists and entertainers (O-1B, P-1B, P-3, support-personnel S classifications), illustratively mapped to Marathi live-performance touring scenarios relevant to the initiative.
spec_note: SYNTHETIC: category names and general structure (duration, consultation requirement) mirror the publicly known USCIS classification scheme for entertainer/artist visas (uscis.gov/working-in-the-united-states/temporary-workers); exact current durations, fees and consultation rules were NOT independently re-verified against a live USCIS page for this build (direct USCIS visa-category page fetch failed) and must be confirmed against uscis.gov before any real filing. This file is illustrative only and is NOT legal/immigration advice.

records.consultation_required_from: Peer group, labor organization, or management organization (mock)
records.initiative_relevance: Would apply to a headline Marathi theatre performer touring individually to the US (mock illustrative note)

records.performer_type: Member of an internationally recognized entertainment group
records.initiative_relevance: Would apply to a touring Marathi theatre troupe/ensemble (mock illustrative note)

records.performer_type: Artist/entertainer in a culturally unique program
records.consultation_required_from: Labor organization and/or a peer group of experts in the cultural art form (mock)
records.initiative_relevance: Likely category for a traditional Marathi cultural/folk performance program touring the US (mock illustrative note)

records.performer_type: Essential support personnel accompanying a P-1/P-2/P-3 performer or group
records.initiative_relevance: Would cover sound/lighting/stage crew travelling with a touring production (mock illustrative note)

records.performer_type: Performer appearing without US-source payment (e.g. showcase/competition only)
records.initiative_relevance: Not suitable for a ticketed/paid Ticketalay US engagement (mock illustrative note)
